candidate_sources.title: Identification and Characterization of Gonatobotryum apiculatum Causing Leaf Spot and Blight on Sinowilsonia henryi
candidate_sources.snippet: Gonatobotryum apiculatum was identified as the causal agent of leaf spot and blight on Sinowilsonia henryi (Hamamelidaceae) based on morphology and sequence analyses. Symptoms, pathogen morphology, and characterization of this Gonatobotryum leaf spot disease are described.

candidate_sources.title: Witchhazel Leaf Spot (Phyllosticta hamamelidis) - Hort Answers, University of Illinois Extension
candidate_sources.snippet: Spots tend to be irregular brown shaped spots with purplish edges on the upper leaf surface; spots may merge to cause larger brown dead areas (blight). Witch-hazel leaf spot/blight is caused by a fungus; the pathogen overwinters on dead plant material and is spread by wind and rain. Management: rake and remove fallen leaves to reduce inoculum.

candidate_sources.title: Phyllosticta Leaf Blotch | Landscape | Center for Agriculture, Food, and the Environment (CAFE) at UMass Amherst
candidate_sources.snippet: Phyllosticta hamamelidis often causes leaf blight on the witchhazels. P. hamamelidis produces small, circular leaf spots that can coalesce to produce large necrotic blotches on infected leaves. The fungus produces tiny, black-colored fruiting bodies (pycnidia) within the necrotic tissue and spores are readily disseminated to healthy foliage during wet weather. Phyllosticta leaf blotch of witch-hazel does not seem to impact the long-term health of infected shrubs.

candidate_sources.title: Phyllosticta Leaf Spot of Ornamentals | Oklahoma State University Extension
candidate_sources.snippet: Phyllosticta Leaf Spot of Ornamentals. On deciduous shrubs like witch-hazel and hydrangea, high levels of shade, moisture and humidity often drive disease outbreaks. Symptoms include brownish, black or tan spots with circular rings leading to a darker margin; when spots combine they can form larger blotches and cause the leaf to turn yellow and drop.
